sentences.en: Once more, the detectives considered him strange, but they didn't go as far as writing a detailed report like Laptew.

sentences.en: But when detectives completed the search, 18 men came back as no trace, meaning they hadn't come up before in the investigation.

sentences.zh: 萨特克利夫仍然因那张纸币接受了审问。

sentences.zh: 总共他又接受了三次单独审问。

sentences.zh: 这些审问发生在1980年1月和2月。

sentences.en: In the first interview he was noted as strange but nothing more.
sentences.zh: 在第一次审问中，他被记录为“奇怪”，但仅此而已。

sentences.en: In the second interview detectives inspected his truck but they found nothing.
sentences.zh: 在第二次审问中，侦探检查了他的卡车，但一无所获。

sentences.en: In the third interview which was actually his ninth overall detectives had managed to dig up some of that background info on Sutcliffe and they were
sentences.zh: 在第三次审问中，也就是他总共第九次接受审问时，侦探们设法挖掘出了一些关于萨特克利夫的背景信息，他们

sentences.zh: 被命令去进一步审问他关于其车辆在红灯区被目击的情况。

sentences.en: but this time they wanted to question him about a Ford Corsair being sighted.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他们想问他关于一辆福特海盗（Ford Corsair）被目击的事情。

sentences.zh: 这些目击事件发生在调查的早期。

sentences.en: They were also ordered to get a proper alibi out of him for the murder of Josephine Whittaker.
sentences.zh: 他们还被要求让他为约瑟芬·惠特克谋杀案提供一个确凿的不在场证明。

sentences.en: The detectives met Sutcliffe at work.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在萨特克利夫工作的地方见到了他。

sentences.en: In relation to his vehicle being sighted in the red light areas, he said he was out with
sentences.zh: 关于他的车曾在红灯区被目击一事，他称自己当时是和

sentences.zh: 索尼娅以及另一对夫妇在一起，但他记不起那对夫妇的姓氏了。

sentences.en: Sonia backed up this story.
sentences.zh: 索尼娅证实了这一说法。

sentences.en: Sutcliffe said that he had taken his Ford Corsair that was sighted in the red light area to a car wrecker.
sentences.zh: 萨特克利夫说，他那辆在红灯区被目击的福特海盗车已经被他送去报废了。

sentences.en: When detectives visited the wrecker, there was no record of that car.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们去报废厂核实时，并没有那辆车的记录。

sentences.en: On the night of Josephine's murder, he said he'd been home with Sonia, which she again confirmed.
sentences.zh: 在约瑟芬遇害的那晚，他说自己和索尼娅待在家里，索尼娅再次对此表示确认。

sentences.en: When they got back to the incident room, the detectives said it was difficult to eliminate
sentences.zh: 当侦探们回到案情室时，他们表示很难排除

sentences.en: Sutcliffe and recommended to start afresh on him if another murder occurred.
sentences.zh: 萨特克利夫的嫌疑，并建议如果再发生谋杀案，就重新对他展开调查。

sentences.en: The inspector though felt they'd gone as far as they could with the information and on the 10th of March 1980 he recommended Sutcliffe's interviews be filed with no further action.
sentences.zh: 然而，督察认为他们掌握的信息已经尽力了，于1980年3月10日建议将萨特克利夫的问话记录归档，不再采取进一步行动。

June 1980 Sutcliffe drove erratically in his Rover saloon and passed two officers in Manningham.
sentences.zh: 萨特克利夫驾驶着他的罗孚轿车在曼宁厄姆行驶时摇摇晃晃，经过了两名警官。

sentences.en: They chased him but didn't actually stop him until he was already parked in his driveway.
sentences.zh: 他们追上了他，但直到他把车停在自家车道上才真正将他拦下。

sentences.en: They arrested him for drunk driving and took him to Bradford station.
sentences.zh: 他们以酒后驾车为由将他逮捕，并带到了布拉德福德警察局。

sentences.zh: 特雷弗·伯德索尔的男子给警方案情室写了一封匿名信，信中写道：致

sentences.en: whom it may concern I am writing to inform you that I have very good reason to believe I know the man you were looking for in the Ripper case.
sentences.zh: 相关负责人，我写这封信是想告知你们，我有充分的理由相信我知道你们在“开膛手”案件中寻找的那个人。

sentences.en: It is an incident which happened within the last five years.
sentences.zh: 这是一起发生在过去五年内的事情。

sentences.en: I could not give any date or place or any details without myself being known to the Ripper or you.
sentences.zh: 我无法提供任何日期、地点或细节，否则我本人就会被“开膛手”或你们发现。

sentences.en: It is only until recently that something came to my notice and now a lot of things fit into place.
sentences.zh: 直到最近我才注意到一些事情，现在很多线索都对上了。

sentences.en: I can only tell you one or two things that fit.
sentences.zh: 我只能告诉你们一两件吻合的事情。

sentences.en: For example, this man has had dealings with sex workers and always had a thing about them.
sentences.zh: 例如，这个人一直与性工作者有往来，而且对她们一直有种特殊的情结。

sentences.en: Also, he is a long-distance truck driver, collecting engineering iteMs. I'm quite sure if you check on dates, you might find something.

sentences.en: His name and address is Peter Sutcliffe, 5 Garden Lane, Shipley, Heaton, Bradford.
sentences.zh: 他的姓名和地址是：彼得·萨特克利夫，布拉德福德希顿希普利花园巷5号。

sentences.zh: 六年前，特雷弗也曾和萨特克利夫一起出去过，当时他殴打了一个女人，但那个女人决定不追究他的责任。

sentences.en: After sending the anonymous letter Trevor's girlfriend told him he hadn't given the police enough information
sentences.zh: 在寄出匿名信后，特雷弗的女友告诉他，他提供给警方的信息不够充分，

sentences.zh: 它有三英尺长，两端和中间都打着结。

sentences.en: When questioned
sentences.zh: 当被问及此事时，

sentences.zh: 萨特克利夫说他用它来修理汽车。

sentences.en: The officers looked at him confused.
sentences.zh: 警官们困惑地看着他。

sentences.en: How do you use this piece of rope to repair a car?
sentences.zh: 你怎么用这根绳子修车？

sentences.zh: 萨特克利夫回答不上来。

sentences.zh: 他回避了很多问题，当他们提出打电话给他的妻子告知她他在哪里时，他给出了一个错误的电话号码。

sentences.en: One of the officers, Officer

sentences.zh: 回到警局内，墙上挂着一张关于“约克郡开膛手”的信息图表。

sentences.zh: 他们问了他一些关于生活的例行问题，然后突然转到他前一天晚上为什么会在谢菲尔德的原因。

sentences.en: Sutcliffe told them that after his drunk driving charge back in June the previous year, he was scared of losing his job as a truck driver
sentences.zh: 萨特克利夫告诉他们，去年6月因酒驾被起诉后，他很担心失去卡车司机的工作，

sentences.zh: 因为当局会吊销他的驾照，而且尝试续保也没有意义。

sentences.zh: 他以为她可能需要某种帮助。
